basics.name: Pascal Garber
basics.label: Software developer — TypeScript, the web and GNOME
basics.summary:
I build software for the web and the Linux desktop, mostly in TypeScript. At CORRECTIV I work on the tools behind independent journalism; as JumpLink I take on client projects and write free software — above all [gjsify](https://gjsify.org/), which brings the Node.js and web ecosystem to GJS, and the GNOME apps I build with it.

I live in Cuxhaven with my two children. Away from the keyboard: cycling, woodworking, survival, retro games and anime.

work.name: CORRECTIV
work.summary: Software for a non-profit newsroom: hardened the security of the beabee membership platform and built its Telegram integration; work in public on GitHub.

work.name: JumpLink / Art+Code Studio
work.summary: Web shops, websites and backend services for clients, from first concept to operation.
highlights: Custom Shopify themes and apps since 2015 — inventory, shipping and accounting integrations, peak loads of thousands of orders a minute
Peek & Cloppenburg: frontend specialist for the international launch, then backend services, TypeScript and testing across teams
Headless shops and sites with Nuxt, Vue, Strapi and Contentful
Riba.js, a web framework on web components, used in production for client themes

projects.name: gjsify
projects.description: Node.js, Deno and web APIs for GJS, a bundler and CLI, and the toolchain to build, test and ship GNOME apps written in TypeScript.

projects.name: ts-for-gir
projects.description: Generates TypeScript types from GObject Introspection data, so GTK and every other introspected library can be written with full type checking.

projects.name: Riba.js
projects.description: A web framework that builds on web components and the DOM instead of a virtual DOM, with client-side routing and server-side rendering.

projects.name: Shopify module for Nest.js
projects.description: Webhooks, API access and authentication for Shopify apps built on Nest.js.
